name: C*Core Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: CCore Technology Co., Ltd., a leading semiconductor design firm based in China, delivers a broad spectrum of integrated circuit solutions. The company specializes in intellectual property (IP) licensing, custom chip development, and the provision of its own brand of chips and modules. These offerings are strategically deployed to bolster security across numerous sectors, encompassing cloud computing, big data analytics, the Internet of Things (IoT), intelligent storage, industrial automation, financial technology, server infrastructures, automotive systems, and smart consumer devices. In addition to its product lines, CCore provides comprehensive design services, including a diverse portfolio of IP products such as CPUs, IP libraries, and third-party tools. It also develops System-on-Chip (SoC) platforms specifically engineered for applications in industrial control, automotive electronics, IoT, and information security. The company further extends its offerings to include biosafety products and integrated software-hardware packages. Fundamentally, CCore's innovations are primarily utilized in critical domains like information security, automotive and industrial control systems, edge computing, and network communications. Established in 2001, the company operates from its headquarters in Suzhou, China.
